title: Seed Scenario Module Compiler
description: Compiles a deterministic, idempotent database seed scenario. Enforces: seeds use upsert/createOrUpdate (not bare insert), no random data unless spec.allowRandom declared, seed order declared explicitly (foreign key order), scenario has a cleanup function, no production data hardcoded.

error_codes.SS002: Seed uses bare insert/create without upsert (not idempotent)
error_codes.SS003: Random data (Math.random, uuid) in seed without spec.allowRandom declaration
error_codes.SS004: No cleanup/teardown function declared (test seeds must be reversible)
error_codes.SS005: Production data detected (real email/phone/SSN pattern in seed values)
